title: Strawberries beat oranges on vitamin C
armature: Gram for gram, strawberries have more vitamin C than oranges (59 vs 53 mg/100 g), and vitamin C builds collagen and helps absorb plant iron, not just immunity.

scenes.narration: Did you know strawberries actually have more vitamin C than oranges?
Yep! Gram for gram, strawberries win!

scenes.label: per 100 g
scenes.narration: 100 grams of strawberries contain about 59 milligrams of vitamin C, compared to 53 in oranges.
sources: USDA FoodData Central: Strawberries, raw (FDC 167762): vitamina C 58.8 mg/100 g; Oranges, raw, all commercial varieties (FDC 169097): 53.2 mg/100 g.

scenes.narration: And vitamin C does more than support your immune system.

scenes.label: the builder
scenes.narration: Your body also needs it to produce collagen, which helps keep your skin, bones, and blood vessels healthy.
sources: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Vitamin C fact sheet: colágeno, función inmune y absorción de hierro no hemo.

scenes.narration: Plus, it helps your body absorb iron from plant-based foods.
So next time you want a vitamin C boost, don't forget about strawberries!
